response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive full-stack and distributed systems experience, including real-time systems (e.g., Dunnhumby) and event-driven platforms (GISCollective), but lacks direct CTO-level leadership in fintech or agentic AI systems. His recent work touches on AI-agent infrastructure (re:cinq) but is not at the scale or domain depth required for this role. The resume also shows limited evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or designing regulatory-compliant financial systems.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with experience in real-time, high-throughput systems (e.g., Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Proven track record in open-source and event-driven architectures (GISCollective)
Demonstrated leadership in technical domains, including DevOps, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship (Altom Consulting, RIDE Capital)
concerns: No explicit experience with fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit systems, payment flows, embedded finance) or agentic AI frameworks at scale
Limited evidence of scaling engineering teams beyond ~10 members or leading hybrid outsourced engineering models
Lacks clear track record in regulated or high-stakes commercial environments with financial consequences
